_about: GROUPS_7 (coordinator, 2026-11-01): grouping from measured confusion (action_confusion.py: the cutter perceptron with one B label per event, test 20%, 516 confusions at the gold request's first token). Actions the cutter mixes up go in one world: 64.5% of the confusions fall inside a group (GROUPS_6: 46.9%, GROUPS_16: 20.0%). Differences from GROUPS_6: check, connected, path, reachable, cycle, exists form one world of questions about the graph (check/connected 30, cycle/path 17, check/path 14, exists/path 6); toFront, toBack go with move (15 + 9). The confusions left across groups are between the big commands (move/set 23, arrange/connect 16, connect/set 13), under 3% of their requests. ROUND 2 (2026-11-02, DIAGRAM_OPS.md section 5): manage += group, ungroup; questions += members, groupOf. The old file GROUPS_7.json is unchanged (cutter_worlds7 / 7s).
